:::{#sol-independent-null-space-practice}

For $\vecf{x} = (x_1, x_2)$,

$$
\matr{A}\vecf{x} = \sbmat{x_1 + 2 x_2 \\ 2 x_1 + 4 x_2 \\ x_2}.
$$

The third entry gives $x_2 = 0$,
and then the first gives $x_1 = 0$.
So $\mathcal{N}(\matr{A}) = \cb{\vzero_2}$,
and by @thm-independent-null-space the [columns of $\matr{A}$](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column)
are [linearly independent](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-linearly-independent).

:::
